about: Benjamin L. Mesches is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Dallas, Texas area. Providing legal representation in Texas for a variety of different issues, Benjamin Mesches was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Benjamin L. Mesches attended law school. Benjamin Mesches was enrolled at The University of Texas School of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 2001. Benjamin Mesches was admitted to the practice of law in 2001.

Attorneys like Benjamin L. Mesches are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Benjamin Mesches represents clients with Appellate issues.
